paite: Judah kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah dam lai a, Kushi tapa, Gedaliah tapa, Amariah tapa, Hezekiah tapa, Zephaniah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
"Leitung a thil om tengteng ka hihbei sipsip ding," TOUPA'N achi.
heading: TOUPA Vaihawmna Ni

paite: "Mihing leh sa ka hihbei ding; van a tungleng vasate, tuipi a ngasate, giloute toh kipalpuknate ka hihbei ding; leitung a pan mihing ka satkhe ding," TOUPA'N achi.
"Judah tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a; hiai mun a kipan in Baal omlaite leh milim biak ching siampute min ka satkhe ding;
Intung a van aksihon bia; TOUPA kiang a kun a kichiam khin napi a, Milkom mai a kichiamte;
TOUPA zuihna a kipan kilehheite leh TOUPA zong lou a, amah kanloute ka satkhe ding hi.”
Toupa PATHIAN ma ah dai sipsip in, TOUPA ni lah anaita ngal a; TOUPA'N lah kithoihna abawlkhol khin a, amisapte ahihsiangthou khinta hi.
TOUPA kithoih ni in hichi ahi ding, heutute leh kumpipa tapate leh gamdang puan a kizem huchibang tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
Huai ni chiang in, phual kan a tawmte, hiamgamna leh khemna a apu uh inn hihdimte, ka gawt ding hi.
"Huai ni chiang in," TOUPA'N achi, Ngasa Kongpi a pan kah thawmging a-om dia, Kongpi Nihna a pan mauna leh mualte a kipan nakpitak a siatna husa a-om ding.
Mau un, nou Maktes a tengte, na sumsin mite tengteng a-omta kei ua; dangka teh mite satkhiak ahita uhi.

Huai hun chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, khawnvak tawi in Jerusalem zong ding ka hi; mi uain dawn a tengden, alungtang ua, TOUPA'N thil hoih hi in thil gilou leng ahih sam kei ding chi mite ka gawt ding hi.
Huchi in ahauhna uh gallak ahong hi dia, a-innte uh asegawp ding; innte alam ding ua, himahleh aluah kei ding uh; grephuante abawl ding ua, himahleh huai a uain adawn kei ding uhi.
TOUPA ni thupi anai a, anai a, akinoh mahmah, TOUPA ni in kah aw athupi ding a; mi thilhihtheitakte huai ah akap loloih ding uhi.
Huai ni thangpaihna ni ahi, lungzinna leh dahna ni, mialna leh lungkiakna ni, meipi leh khomial bikbek ahi;
pengkul leh gallauna ni, khopi daikaih siatna, aning a insangte siat ni.
Huan mite tung ah dahna ka tun ding a, mittawte bang in avak ding uh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak un; huchi in asisan uh leivui bang leh asa uh eklei bang in butkhiak in a-om ding hi.

TOUPA thangpaihna ni chiang in adangka uhiam adangka-eng uhiam in amaute atan thei kei ding; himahleh amullitna mei in gam pumpi akangbei ding a; hihbei a om ding ahih ziak in, beina mulkimhuai, gamsung a tengte tengteng tung ah a-om ding hi.
